scheme_name: Schemes for welfare of School Children belonging to BPL and BC(A) families: Monthly Stipend for BC(A) Students
other_conditions: Must belong to Backward Classes category (A).
Must be a student in classes 1 to 12.
Must be enrolled in a Haryana Government school.
Must maintain at least 50% attendance to continue receiving benefits.
Must have an active bank account for stipend transfer.
benefits_summary: Monthly stipend ranging from ₹75 to ₹400 per student, amount varying by class and gender, transferred directly to the beneficiary's bank account.
